name: Nozh Roastery Cafe

location.address: Sanat Sq, start of Iran Zamin Blvd, first alley on the right, Shahrak Gharb, Tehran

description: A minimalist, mostly-white cafe-bakery-roastery by chef-influencer Navvab Ebrahimi in Shahrak Gharb. Strong on cold brew, pour-over, matcha drinks and a quality pastry and croissant counter. Easy parking, professional service, 7:30-23:30 daily.
